flavor.phonemic_palette: Frankish/OHG backbone (High German shift th>d, d>t, k>ch/hh; w>w/wu; -o/-i) with Anglo-Saxon overlay touches (w-, th retained, weak -a; OE place-words); theophoric stems are the Frankish reflexes (Dulro-, Erlant-, Giando-) with AS variants (Thulor-, Eorland-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Anglo-Saxon + Frankish per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Anglo-Saxon + Frankish register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'ostran'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Ostran — wary feudal of the grassland; honor, duty.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Ostran (Anglo-Saxon + Frankish) are a assertive feudal people seeded in grassland, forest, hills. They prize honor, duty, family, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, heavy_cavalry, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, harvest, law.
